panoramas.title: Sculpture Gallery
panoramas.subtitle: Indoor exhibition
panoramas.description: Step into a contemporary gallery filled with expressive sculptures and mixed-media works.

hotspots.title: Wooden Horse
hotspots.description: A life-sized wooden horse anchors the center of the exhibition and draws the visitor into the room.

hotspots.title: Human Figures
hotspots.description: Figurative works explore posture, material, and the relationship between people and space.

hotspots.title: Continue Outside
hotspots.description: Leave the gallery and continue the tour in the urban courtyard.

panoramas.title: Urban Courtyard
panoramas.subtitle: Outdoor architecture
panoramas.description: Explore an open city courtyard framed by modern architecture, public art, and bright natural light.

hotspots.title: Courtyard Sculpture
hotspots.description: A public sculpture creates a visual landmark at the entrance to the courtyard.

hotspots.title: Contemporary Facade
hotspots.description: Glass, stone, and shaded walkways shape the public edge of this urban space.

hotspots.title: Return to Gallery
hotspots.description: Go back inside and revisit the sculpture exhibition.
